scope_defaults.space: all real H1 functions with E_mu(u)=0

conventions: Power coefficients ascend in t. All potentials are real.
Rayleigh quotients use either area or probability measure consistently; the factors cancel for spectral quantities. GN constants do change.
Full mean-zero means compression to the closed mean-zero quadratic-form domain, not deleting the first ordinary eigenvalue.
m>0 real full-spectrum multiplicity is 2; sector k and full-space k differ.
Fixed challenges may expose missing scope, resource limits or valid wide bounds; none implies the old algorithm returned a false proof.
No challenge is advertised as an open mathematical problem; no later version is predeclared successful.
A future change to a challenge must retain this original and document the reason; failures are not silently removed.

sphere.title: DLMF 14.30: Spherical and Spheroidal Harmonics
sphere.use: Unit sphere harmonic eigenvalues and angular basis; exact constant-potential calibrations also derived directly.

usov.title: Usov, Spheroidal quantum well, arXiv:2307.04124v1, Eq.7a and Table1c
usov.use: For q=+c^2 t^2, m=1, c^2=2, l=1: Lambda=2.38265540616. Only compatibility with the fixed rounding interval plus/minus 0.5e-11; not a rigorous high precision enclosure.

dlmf_spheroid.title: DLMF 30.2: Differential Equations
dlmf_spheroid.use: Convention conversion Lambda=lambda_DLMF+c^2 for q=+c^2 t^2. Positive c^2 here is prolate.

gn.title: Ilyin and Zelik, On a class of interpolation inequalities on the 2D sphere, arXiv:2204.12414v1
gn.use: Eq.1.8 gives a nonsharp scalar zero-mean interpolation upper bound. At exponent r=4 its probability-measure form is E(u^4) <= 4 E(u^2) E(|grad u|^2). It does not identify the sharp GN constant. The paper also motivates orthonormal-density / spectral trace work.

cases.title: 零势显式违反者
acceptance: Return an exact nonzero mean-zero trial and directly replay its moments: mass=1/3, energy=2/3, Rayleigh=2.
Verify threshold*mass-energy=1/30>0; spectral existence alone is insufficient.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: weighted_poincare is applicable but records existence-only refutation.

cases.title: 椭球势的严格有理违反者
acceptance: Independently integrate the displayed polynomial trial on S2 and prove mass>0, mean=0 and Rayleigh<12/5.
Report the actual positive violation margin with original potential and full-sphere scope.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Existence refutation is supported; no explicit function in V94 output.

cases.title: 固定m=1势的二十四位证书宽度
acceptance: Replay an exact interval of width <=1e-24, or report the remaining open width and resource budget.
The independent Usov rounding band [2.382655406155,2.382655406165] is a compatibility check only; it cannot certify 24 digits.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Fixed sector supported; probe fixed N=8,bits=100 to distinguish truncation error from arithmetic precision.

cases.title: 强势全角向二十位闭合
acceptance: Replay a full-space interval of width <=1e-20 including an explicit omitted-angular-sector lower bound, or keep certified_bound_open_gap.
Do not infer high precision merely from bits=100 or reuse an m=0-only interval as a full-space result.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: full_ground supports the input; limited truncation is deliberately probed.

cases.title: 八次非负势
acceptance: Accept degree 8 with exact coefficient binding and global potential range.
Coarse independent guard: 2 <= full mean-zero ground <=67/33, using u=x and E(z^(2r))=1/(2r+1); requested narrow result must independently replay.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: V94 degree cap 6 rejects this input.

cases.title: GN六次试探平方产生十二次势
acceptance: Bind the expanded degree-12 polynomial exactly to the factored trial square.
Independent guard q>=-36/49 gives full mean-zero ground >=62/49; a successful spectral certificate must cover the whole interval, not samples.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: V94 degree cap 6 rejects this natural trial-square input.

cases.title: 整个线性参数区间的统一正下界
acceptance: Prove lambda_mean_zero(a*t)>=1 for every a in [-4,4].
One admissible proof uses concavity of the constrained ground energy in a plus verified endpoint lower bounds; a finite grid without a remainder is insufficient.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Pointwise endpoints supported; no parameter-box certificate API.

cases.title: 非负参数盒与端点精确达到
acceptance: Prove the uniform threshold 2 from q>=0 and Poincare, with equality at a=0 and u=x.
Bind the full parameter box; sampling the endpoints must not be presented as the general proof.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Fixed coefficients supported; uniform quantifier and exact minimizer are outside the API.

cases.title: 带惩罚的参数全局最优
acceptance: Return rigorous lower and attained/trial upper bounds for the global objective with gap <=1e-8, or retain an explicit open gap.
Cover the whole parameter interval and all relevant angular branches; attach proof to any reported minimizer enclosure. No optimal parameter/value is assumed in advance.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: A fixed a can be evaluated; no global parameter optimizer/certificate API.

cases.title: 正负椭球势的角分支竞争
acceptance: At a=-2 and a=2 establish competing m=0/m=1 intervals and identify a winning branch only after separation; retain undecided labels if they overlap.
At a=0 prove full mean-zero eigenvalue 2 with real multiplicity 3 (one m=0 plus two m=1). Do not infer uniqueness or a whole-box branch ordering from only these three points.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Pointwise sectors and full ground supported; branch-family claims require new machinery.

cases.title: 删除完整l=0和l=1空间
acceptance: Ground energy is exactly 6; prove all constraints and accept an l=2 trial such as 3z^2-1.
Excluding only m=0,l=1 is insufficient because the x/y modes remain.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Only the constant constraint is available in V94.

cases.title: 只删除常数和z仍保留横向模
acceptance: In the full sphere the ground is exactly 2, with admissible x and y.
For the separately declared axisymmetric space the same constraints give ground 6; scope binding must distinguish the two.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: No extra-constraint API; full and axisymmetric meanings must not be conflated.

cases.title: 完整高阶谱与重数
acceptance: Return [2,2,2,6,6,6,6,6,12], including real angular multiplicities.
Each sector may be certified independently, but a full-spectrum merge must also exclude omitted levels/sectors.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Fixed-sector kth eigenvalue is supported; full_ground only returns full-space k=1.

cases.title: 负谱个数及负部迹
acceptance: Mean-zero result: negative count 8 and negative-part trace 20 (l=1:3*5; l=2:5*1).
Unprojected result: negative count 9 and trace 27; prove no omitted negative eigenvalues. These are exact test identities, not a new Lieb-Thirring bound.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Sector energies are available; full counting and negative-trace sum API are absent.

cases.title: GN候选常数的直接反例
acceptance: Direct moments are E(u^2)=1/3, E(|grad u|^2)=2/3, E(u^4)=1/5; quotient=9/10>4/5.
If using area d_sigma instead, the same trial quotient is 9/(40*pi), not 9/10. A weighted linear spectral threshold is not a GN certificate.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: V94 certifies linear quadratic forms, not this quartic functional.

cases.title: 明确集中序列的有理矩与GN试探
acceptance: For each prescribed n, independently integrate mean, M2, M4 and Dirichlet energy and return the exact rational GN quotient.
M2=2^(2n)*(1/(2n+1)-1/(n+1)^2); energy=n*2^(2n-1)/(2n+1). M4 follows binomial expansion with E((1+t)^j)=2^j/(j+1).
All three cases stay in the record even if a resource limit is reached. No claim that these trials are globally optimal or attain the sharp constant.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: No GN moment/search interface; potential squares would exceed degree 6 for these trials.

cases.title: 旋转等价的非轴输入q=x
acceptance: Certify the full mean-zero ground and reproduce the q=z result under an explicit rotation of S2.
Preserve the mean-zero constraint and full-space scope; comparing only the old m=0 sector is not a rotation test.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: The axisymmetric q(t) API cannot directly represent x; it can supply the rotated calibration q=z.

cases.title: 真正三轴二次势
acceptance: Replay a full-sphere certificate for x^2+2y^2+3z^2, which has no rotation making it a function of one axis alone.
Independent coarse guard is 3 <= ground <=18/5: q>=1 and the trial u=x has potential quotient 8/5 and Dirichlet quotient 2.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: Nonaxisymmetric coefficients/couplings are outside V94 input scope.

cases.title: 同一谱证书支持两个后续判定
acceptance: One replayed full-space certificate with L>=119/50 and U<12/5 yields proved and refuted-by-spectral-existence respectively.
Preserve certificate identity and avoid recomputing the spectrum in both downstream steps; any explicit violating-function extension must be separately checked.
Reject changed q or scope bindings and corrupt content hashes.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: V94 already supports content-addressed storage, verify and fetch. Its weighted_poincare operation recomputes the spectrum and takes no existing certificate id. This challenge extends reuse, not basic persistence.

cases.title: 开放证书的预算续算
acceptance: First preserve and replay the honest open certificate. A resumed result must keep best lower=max(old lower,new lower) and best upper=min(old upper,new upper) for the same operator.
Record actual reused work and certificate ancestry; a fresh full recomputation may be a correct fallback but is not evidence of warm-start reuse.
If the larger budget still cannot close 1e-20, retain open status. Reject an inherited certificate with changed coefficients or projection.
cases.frozen_v94_baseline: V94 has persisted certificates but full_ground has no seed/resume option.
